newsitem.title: USA: Paxson to buy Comark digital TV equipment.
newsitem.headline: Paxson to buy Comark digital TV equipment.

text.p: Paxson Communications Corp, a nationwide owner and operator of broadcast television stations, said Friday it has signed a strategic alliance with privately-held Comark Communications Inc, a provider of digital television equipment.
Paxson said that it will receive priority deliveries on Comark's equipment and services, as well as favorable pricing.

The agreement, said Paxson, also calls for it and Comark to assess its long term digital transmission requirements, and for Comark to manufacture, install and service its new Advantage Line, high power UHF transmitters throughout Paxson's nationwide network.
The company did not disclose any financial terms of the agreement.
Paxson added that the recent FCC ruling allowing it to add new digital channels will help it achieve its goal of reaching 70 percent of US television households.

After completing all previously announced acquisitions and dispositions, Paxson will have 47 owned, operated or affiliated television stations in markets reaching 54.4 percent of US television households.
